point.title: 一般将来时
point.summary: 一般将来时表示将要发生的动作,常与 tomorrow、next week、soon 连用。两种结构:will + 动词原形;be(am/is/are) going to + 动词原形。否定:will not = won't;be not going to。一般疑问把 will 或 be 提到句首。There will be… 表示“将会有”。
point.examples: I will visit my grandma tomorrow. / She is going to buy a bag. / Will you help me?

questions.stem: I ____ visit my grandma tomorrow.
questions.explanation: will + 动词原形表将来。

questions.stem: She will ____ us next week.
questions.explanation: will 后接动词原形。

questions.stem: They ____ going to have a party.
questions.explanation: be going to 结构中主语为复数用 are。

questions.stem: It ____ rain this afternoon.
questions.explanation: will 表将来,后接原形 rain。

questions.stem: We are going to ____ a film tonight.
questions.explanation: be going to 后接动词原形。

questions.stem: He ____ be twelve next year.
questions.explanation: next year 表将来,用 will be。

questions.stem: There ____ be a sports meeting tomorrow.
questions.explanation: There will be 表“将会有”。

questions.stem: My friends ____ going to visit Beijing.
questions.explanation: be going to 中复数主语用 are。

questions.stem: You ____ see him soon.
questions.explanation: soon 表将来,用 will。

questions.stem: ____ you help me with my English?
questions.explanation: will 的一般疑问把 will 提前。

questions.stem: He ____ come to the party because he is ill.
questions.explanation: won't = will not,表将来否定。

questions.stem: — Will it be sunny tomorrow? — Yes, it ____.
questions.explanation: will 疑问的肯定简答用 will。

questions.stem: ____ she going to buy a new bag?
questions.explanation: be going to 的疑问用 be,单数用 Is。

questions.stem: We ____ not going to stay at home this weekend.
questions.explanation: be going to 否定在 be 后加 not。

questions.stem: — Will they arrive soon? — No, they ____.
questions.explanation: will 疑问的否定简答用 won't;无 willn't。

questions.stem: There ____ be any classes next Sunday.
questions.explanation: There will be 的否定用 won't be。

questions.stem: What ____ you do this weekend?
questions.explanation: 询问将来计划用 will。

questions.stem: My sister ____ go to school tomorrow because she ____ visit the doctor.
questions.explanation: 将来否定 won't + 原形;肯定 will + 原形。

questions.stem: — What are you going to do next Sunday? — I ____ going to ____ my uncle.
questions.explanation: be going to 中主语 I 用 am,后接原形 visit。

questions.stem: Look at the clouds. It ____ rain soon, so I ____ take an umbrella.
questions.explanation: 两处都表将来,用 will + 原形。
